As a member of our dynamic team, you will have the exceptional opportunity to help create the next generation of products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple customers every day. title: Security Software Engineering Manager - Platform and Frameworks
descriptionHtml:
The SPEAR team in Apple’s Security Engineering & Architecture organization is hiring a collaborative OS platform software engineering manager with a drive to improve the security of end user devices.

SPEAR is a dedicated team of software engineers who work on security hardening across all of Apple’s operating systems. We operate as a tiger team to do hands-on work deploying security improvements wherever they are most needed. These improvements range from targeted adoptions of memory safety technologies to wholesale refactors that reorient key system components to build security into the core. Our work results in significant improvements to the security of Apple’s apps and services without compromising the polished user experience over a billion users rely on every day.

As an engineering manager in SPEAR, you will lead projects in collaboration with the maintainers of core operating system components to make meaningful and sustainable security improvements. Your team will deliver well-designed, robust, and maintainable software features that meaningfully improve end user security. Your team’s accomplishments will dramatically accelerate progress on improving the security of our users’ devices. As a leader in a growing organization, you will hire and develop talented engineers who will help set the standard for cross-functional collaboration and engineering excellence.

As a result of the collective effort of dedicated engineers like yourself, Apple’s products are the most secure consumer devices on the market. Our mission is to continue to advance the state of the art of end user security. Our goal isn’t simply to be the most secure: we’re working to ensure the safety of every user’s digital life, even against the most malicious and well-resourced adversaries.

Apple is the best place to do on-device machine learning, and this team sits at the heart of that discipline, interfacing with research, SW engineering, HW engineering, and products.

The team builds critical infrastructure that begins with onboarding the latest machine learning architectures to embedded devices, optimization toolkits to optimize these models to better suit the target devices, machine learning compilers and runtimes to execute these models as efficiently as possible, and the benchmarking, analysis and debugging toolchain needed to improve on new model iterations. This infrastructure underpins most of Apple’s critical machine learning workflows across Camera, Siri, Health, Vision, etc., and as such is an integral part of Apple Intelligence.

Our group is looking for an On-Device ML Quality Infrastructure Engineer. The role involves building and maintaining the infrastructure used to connect, validate, and benchmark the components of the On-Device Machine Learning stack.

title: Software Engineer - System Scheduling Performance
descriptionHtml:
Allocating resource usage efficiently is a key differentiator for Apple products. The System Scheduling Performance team, part of CoreOS, builds the background task scheduler that runs on every one of our platforms, sitting at the intersection of power, performance, and feature latency. We schedule workloads intelligently in optimal device conditions, accounting for feature usage history, battery life, thermals, network efficiency, memory, and more. This technology is the foundation of features such as Siri AI, Apple Intelligence, Photo Processing, Automatic Software Updates, Background App Refresh, iCloud Photo Library, and many more! In this highly visible role, you will design a scalable scheduling system to handle the ever increasing demand for background processing, and help teams across Apple adopt these operating system concepts.

The team is looking for innovative candidates to design and implement new capabilities to manage process runtime and resource utilization across our diverse product lines. In this highly visible role, you will be driving the development of a scalable architecture for resource management, as well as influencing and assisting cross-functional teams with the adoption of these new operating system concepts. Through the combination of effective collaboration, data and performance analysis, software prototyping, and systems engineering, you will push the boundary of what's possible at the core of the operating system!

The team manages the continuous operation, maintenance, and evolution of the world's largest single-instance SAP deployment — a platform that sustains Apple's global supply chain and the integrity of its core financial systems.

Our team builds and implements leading-edge supply chain solutions using SAP S/4 HANA applications that have helped keep Apple #1 in customer support for multiple years in a row. We are seeking a high-energy and self-driven SAP MM/LE Functional Analyst/Project Lead who will play a central role in the design and development of supply chain execution solutions.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml: Come join Apple's growing wireless silicon development team. descriptionHtml:

At Apple's Siri team, we're building the next generation of agents and deploying them at the largest customer scale in the world. descriptionHtml: The Apple Services Engineering team is one of the most exciting examples of Apple’s long-held passion for combining art and technology. And they do it on a massive scale, meeting Apple’s high expectations with dedication to deliver a huge variety of entertainment in over 35 languages to more than 150 countries. Apple Fitness+ application is a cutting edge solution that brings world class workouts and meditations from highly qualified fitness trainers motivating and encouraging millions of people. Building on our existing achievements, we are eager to continue our journey even further. As we continue our expansion into the Fitness space, we are looking for a talented, passionate QA engineer who can help us achieve the kind of product quality that Apple is known for. title: Engineering Manager, CloudKit Infrastructure - iCloud
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for the systems that enable our cloud infrastructure to operate at scale with exceptional reliability, integrity, security, and efficiency. This is a technically grounded role, ideal for leaders passionate about distributed databases, storage systems, and building large-scale, resilient infrastructure.

You will be working on CloudKit, Apple’s foundational, privacy-focused database platform, which stores and syncs user data across all their Apple devices. It is the foundation of Apple’s signature cloud services, such as Photos, Drive, Backup, Notes, Mail, News, and many third-party applications.

CloudKit manages data at a truly massive scale! It is a strongly consistent database of structured data that serves billions of active Apple customers. It is purposely built to be performant, highly available, and extremely scalable, with privacy at its core. CloudKit empowers developers to build highly collaborative and secure applications.

title: Video Processing Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Do you love problem solving in a collaborative environment and then having the results of your efforts benefitting millions around the world? At Apple, our Architecture group is responsible for connecting our hardware and software into one unified system. Join this team, and you’ll collaborate with engineers across Apple to design how all of our technologies work in unison! You’ll drive development of our renowned system-on-a-chip architecture and develop algorithms to improve image quality and enable new use cases. You’ll develop forward-looking prototype systems as well as build and deploy software development tools that will be distributed to the Apple engineering community and help build the seamless technology experiences we’re known for worldwide.

This role will be responsible for investigating techniques for improving video processing solutions along the quality vs. power axes. State-of-the-art video processing solutions often involve the use of Machine Learning, but this can be computationally intensive and not practical. There exists a computational gap between Machine Learning techniques and traditional methods. The goal is to find operating points in between that can leverage the improved quality due to Machine Learning when needed and fall back to traditional, low-compute methods when not needed. Examples of video processing solutions that can benefit from using a hybrid solution comprised of traditional techniques and Machine Learning based techniques include (but not limited to) 1) Under Display Camera enhancement 2) Motion Estimation for Codec, GGM and MCTF 3) Face ID processing. The result of finding hybrid solutions is better video quality and/or longer battery life on the Phone, Pad and Mac. You will be responsible for investigating hybrid video processing techniques that can be translated into efficient SoC architectures. You will be expected to be able to translate architectures into specifications and C-models. You will also be expected to work cross-functionally with other Architects as well as Design and DV.

title: RF PLL Silicon Validation Engineer (Early Careers)
descriptionHtml:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion, dedication, and a no-excuse mindset to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here.

Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic cellular transceivers. We are looking for a motivated RF engineer with strong programming skills to join our PLL validation efforts. This is a hands-on role where you will verify that our new silicon designs meet specifications, working in an agentic engineering flow where you direct AI agents across specs, code, lab setups and data, while staying accountable for the result. title: Traffic and Secure Services Network SRE Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Apple, we build systems that power services used by hundreds of millions of people around the world, and every second counts. The Services Engineering organization is at the heart of this mission, ensuring our platforms are performant, secure, and always available. We're seeking a technically strong Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our growing team, focused on the future of traffic management, load balancing, and secure networking infrastructure.

You’ll play a key role in shaping the next generation of how services communicate securely and efficiently across Apple’s global ecosystem. This isn’t just about keeping systems up, it’s about redefining how traffic flows through one of the world’s most critical networks.

Our team owns a foundational platform that service teams across Apple depend on for high availability, performance, and security. From intelligent routing to secure TLS termination, we’re building scalable infrastructure solutions that empower internal developers while protecting user privacy and system integrity.

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Platforms Engineering, Enterprise Technology Services
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it!

Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it.

Forge is part of Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), within Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. Forge is building the platform Apple's engineering organizations can use to take a service from code to running in production. That path has traditionally run through a series of separate specialist systems. We are bringing it together on a common platform with a shared core, so a team goes from allocated capacity to a live production service without assembling the pieces themselves. Our job is to get teams to production quickly, on a platform that stays secure and reliable without them having to think about it.

Our charter is deliberately wide and still growing, reaching from the physical fleet in the data center to the surfaces engineering teams build against, and extending into new environments and new classes of infrastructure as Apple's needs evolve. We are a small team with outsized reach, bringing an AI-first mindset to how the platform operates and improves itself, and the best work we do takes one team's hardest problem and turns it into a capability every team inherits.
